notes: Modified cash basis school district, governmental funds only (no business-type funds; school nutrition is a governmental fund). Statement receipts/disbursements use the Total Governmental Funds column on p5 (Exhibit D, after eliminating 205,312 of transfers; total column shows transfers as zero so transfers_in/out are null). Beginning cash = beginning fund balance 3,853,270 (p5). Taxes: Other 1,650,134 split into carline, homestead, property tax credit and pro-rate using fund schedules (ties). Other student support 572,611 split into food service (Nutrition Fund 384,015) and activities (remainder; Activities Fund prints 188,597, 1 off). Debt service split from Exhibit M. Other local receipts 227,670 kept whole (mostly activity receipts). General Fund spending detail is Exhibit N (object detail by program, p17-22; Exhibit G program lines are not duplicated); its by-program subtotals tie to Exhibit G actuals and the lines sum to 7,856,819 + transfers 205,312 = 8,062,131 (p22). Transfers 205,312 sit inside General Fund total disbursements; Exhibit N (p22) breaks them into School nutrition fund 200,000 and Activity Fund 5,312, recorded as signed other financing printed_in expenditure. School Nutrition shows its 200,000 (p14); the Activities Fund schedule (p13) has no transfer line, so a contra line moves 5,312 out of its account receipts into other financing. Activities Fund budget is one line so the per-account schedule is used. Employee Benefit Fund had no disbursements. Balance sheet is the cash-basis Statement of Net Position (p1); no liabilities. Exhibit G beginning/ending fund balances and expenditure budget columns not otherwise captured. Read pages 1-22 of 22
